name: Signature cut & finish
summary: A considered cut, finished your way.
description: A one-to-one consultation, a thoughtful cut shaped around your texture and routine, and a finish that feels like you.

name: Wash, cut & style
summary: A reset, a shape-up, and a good blow-dry.
description: Settle in for a restorative wash, a tailored haircut, and a polished blow-dry with a few easy tips for recreating the look at home.

name: Color consultation
description: Bring your ideas, references, or just a feeling. Your colorist will assess your hair and map out a considered plan before any color work begins.

name: Single-process color
summary: Rich, even color with a natural finish.
description: A single all-over color service chosen to complement your features and finished with a professional style. Final pricing may vary with hair length and product use.

name: Highlights & balayage
description: Hand-painted dimension and carefully placed highlights, planned around your starting color and desired result. A consultation is recommended before your first color service.

name: Classic cut
description: A relaxed consultation and a precise scissor or clipper cut, finished with a clean neckline and styling to suit your day-to-day.

name: Skin fade
summary: A clean blend with a precise finish.
description: A detailed fade blended from skin to your chosen length, finished with crisp edges and styling. Let your barber know if you have a reference in mind.

name: Beard trim & shape
description: A shape-up and trim tailored to your beard growth, face shape, and preferred finish, with tidy edges and a little post-service care.

name: Hot towel shave
description: A traditional close shave with warm towels, careful preparation, and a soothing finish. Take a moment, get comfortable, and leave feeling refreshed.

name: Cut & beard
summary: The full tidy-up, all in one chair.
description: A tailored haircut paired with a beard trim and shape, so the whole look feels considered and balanced.
